It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-until-you-2|Do Not]]ing on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series.
